“The Family Album” blends those two ideas in a creative, emotionally resonant, and frequently funny world premiere musical that tackles the raw, transformative journey of healing intergenerational trauma.
The Family Album posee todos los elementos de un musical memorable: una historia emocionalmente resonante, personajes complejos, música poderosa y un mensaje universal.
As dark as this show may sound, the musical is filled with many humorous and heartwarming moments.
The Family Album is a creative, great new musical that is true to life and frequently moving.
The music is very enjoyable, sparking conversation and reflection.

rv.o: To See or Not to See
rv.q: All of the actors nail their numbers, making the musical tight and polished.
The Family Album is the kind of new musical that feels destined for a Broadway future.

cn.t: Critics praise this heartfelt world premiere musical for its emotionally truthful exploration of family dynamics and generational trauma, highlighting MILCK and AG's indie-pop score and the production's universal resonance through intimate storytelling.
